Hi Ethan,

Thanks for signing up and showing interest in Redwood Dedicated. I saw your trial usage and the note that you're evaluating for production throughput/latency — happy to help get a short technical demo scheduled.

Quick ask so we tailor the session: can you confirm target sustained throughput (tokens/sec) and typical request shape (avg seq len, batch vs single-shot)? From initial signals, we want to make sure we bring the right engineer and a Dedicated sizing proposal.

Proposed slots:
- Wed Mar 22, 10:00 AM PT
- Thu Mar 23, 11:00 AM PT

If those don't work, send a couple windows that do and we'll adapt. The demo will be ~45 minutes (brief product overview + dedicated sizing and Q&A) and we'll bring an infra engineer to cover KV cache, batching, and quantization tradeoffs.

Looking forward —
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — happy to meet. A bit of context on our workload:
- Primary use: real-time assist in our analytics UI (avg seq len ~120 tokens)
- Peak concurrency: ~100 active users, ~10 qps average, spikes to 40 qps
- Target: p95 < 150ms for single-turn queries, and sustain ~500 tokens/sec for batch backfills

Those targets are high priority for the infra team; we'd like to see evidence of sustained throughput and the typical latency profile on Dedicated (p50/p95/p99).

I can do Thu Mar 23 11:00 AM PT. I attached a short requirements doc that lists our traffic patterns. Please include your infra/solutions engineer.

Thanks,
Ethan Wu
Head of Platform, Nimbus Analytics
E: ethan.wu@nimbus-analytics.com
Attachment: nimbus_requirements_v1.pdf
